# Native skygo task files keep their own decoder, argv and target.
skygo plan native.yaml
stdout '^local$'
! stderr .

skygo run -f native.yaml --request-id native-1
stdout '^native-1\tlocal\tsucceeded$'

# SkyPilot options never override a native task.
! skygo plan native.yaml --target other
stderr 'apply only to SkyPilot task YAML'
! skygo run native.yaml --shell /bin/bash --request-id native-2
stderr 'apply only to SkyPilot task YAML'

-- native.yaml --
argv: [echo, run]
env: {MODE: native}
cpu_millis: 250
target: local
